Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/50743

Since https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62845 this is unnecessary as `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is always called when a control/window node enters the tree.

regex: `(case (NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE|NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED):\n*\t*){2,}`

Including https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62845 this speeds up editor start time opening an empty project [by about 7%](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62846#issuecomment-1204710636)
pr_comments: Okay, it turns out that `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` isn't unconditionally called in `NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE`, although https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62845 would fix that; so https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62845 should be merged first.

issue_context.title: `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is getting called when it shouldn't
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

883bb2f4f657fa38da07efc1f04f35b5c8923120

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description
<details>
<summary>
See https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/devel?msg=J4SjAHxFmwZ7NHYqQ
</summary>

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50304111/169947484-b6e93913-cf3b-4cea-b89c-3b822498164b.png)
</details>

When opening a project in 3.x, `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` consistently gets called 8 times (or at least on the `FileSystemDock` and `ProjectExportDialog` which were what I tested. In master it's only 3 times).

When running the project manager in 3.x, `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is only called 3 times in `EditorAbout` (although it doesn't get called at all in master because (maybe by mistake?) `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` [was removed from `EditorAbout` in master](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/4758057f205a7d2e0d2db2c034705b7afcdf310f#diff-35a6b6fb0e84d2469de9ad1bd4b47405b9e1eb58a74b2529ae404c1f922c649dR53)).

 `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is also called when/right before an object is destroyed it seems (or at least when closing the editor.

In master `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is only called three times.
### Steps to reproduce

Insert a breakpoint in `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments:
So the reason it's getting called 3 times is
1. For  `case NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE`
2. `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` gets called in `NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE`
3. `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGE` gets propagated to all children in `add_child_notify`. Note this doesn't get called if the control's parent isn't also a control.

`_propagate_theme` is also used to set the theme_owner to nullptr in `remove_child_notify`, but there's no check in `_propagate_theme` to see if the control is being removed or added, which is why `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` also gets called when the control is removed. Calling `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` only really needs to be done when a control node is entering the scene tree, as none of the theme changes will be visible when the node is outside of the tree.

I understand why `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is called so 3 times in master, but I haven't looked into why it's getting called so much more often in 3.x (8 times instead of 3). For whatever reason the control's theme is emitting `changed` several times, calling `_theme_changed`, which is what is causing all the extra notifications.

review_comments: Worth noting that this was handling `VISIBILITY_CHANGED`. Does it change the behavior?

I'll check, but I don't see anything special about this case, it seems like it should just be using `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`

Edit: looks fine to me:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50304111/187041984-31b7bab6-2527-42b5-b3f5-1b4606a4aa0e.png)
Worth noting that it's not exactly equivalent (now it will reset the gutter width on all theme changes), but it's probably fine anyway.
Nitpick, there should be a separation line between `case`s (unless it's a fallthrough) for readability, as they're often quite big.
It'd be neat if this could be added to clang-format 👀

This was added to prevent crashes as EditorHelp could receive this notification while not in tree - did you check that this is no longer the case?

See #32985 and referenced issues/PRs for details.

It's the same thing as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e06cd2742f8af57b23fa11dec62ba9c4eb544291/editor/plugins/texture_editor_plugin.cpp#L41-L49

`NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` is the only `case` here, and it should now only be called when the node is inside of the tree, so this check is redundant.

I tried to document it pretty well here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/74eb2a70bd7ab881776b30fb34bf98d03651bf52/doc/classes/Control.xml#L1177-L1184

Previously `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` was also getting called from `remove_child_notify` which I changed so it won't anymore. That's what caused the crash from #32985 and #50702. It actually didn't used to be this way a long time ago:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/259418f8275371fc2f0bab6892caa4ef66b84240/scene/gui/control.cpp#L425-L450
Note how `notification(NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED)` is commented out. At some point `add_child_notify` and `remove_child_notify` were changed to use `_propagate_theme_changed`, which always send `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` regardless of where it's called from.
